1. Start with weights that give the mean of the neighbors, and P = I / delta.
2. For each pixel in raster order, predict it from its neighbors.
3. Write the prediction, or the error.
4. Compute the gain, move the weights by the gain times the error, and update P.
5. Make P symmetric and cap its trace, against rounding and windup.
